title: encrypt.rs: build_p256_recipient and build_p384_recipient are structural duplicates
description: smime-tree/src/encrypt.rs: build_p256_recipient and build_p384_recipient are structurally identical functions differing only in their type parameters (P256/P384), KDF OID, key-wrap OID, and CEK size constant. Any future bug fix or feature change must be applied twice and kept in sync. The existing do_wrap! macro shows the codebase already addresses this pattern with macros; a generic build_kari_recipient<C, D>(cek, recipient_cert, kdf_oid, wrap_oid) would eliminate the duplication at the cost of slightly more complex type bounds. As-is, a one-line correctness fix in one function can silently leave the other broken.
